title: tecoma princei
intro: Tecoma princei, commonly known as Prince's Cup, is a flowering plant species in the bignonia family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma princei include its antimicrobial and antitumor properties, which can help to combat infections and cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
